name: hole_mirrored_on_right
why: THE HOLE MUST APPEAR ON THE OTHER SIDE, and the volume alone does not say so. A hole at (60, 25) mirrored on the right plane -- which is YZ, that is x = 0 -- must give a copy at (-60, 25): x flips, y does NOT. If the mirror took the wrong plane the build would succeed just the same, the volume would come back to the cubic millimetre and the part would be another one.
_why_it_is_not_centered: the hole is neither at the centre nor on the axis of symmetry on purpose: on a centred hole the mirror is indistinguishable from doing nothing.
